caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica means learning when to stop arguing with the grade. There are climbs along the ridgelines where pushing your bike is simply the pace the mountain asks of you. Then the canopy opens, the breeze comes up from the valley below, and the quiet ahead belongs to no one else.
